subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

COVID-19 _________ structural weaknesses in health systems worldwide and negatively impacted individuals, societies, and economies.
solution:
The correct answer is: **revealed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Revealed:** To make known; to show or uncover something that was not previously known. (प्रकट किया)

 
 
• Example: The investigation revealed several illegal activities within the company.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that global health systems were found to have fundamental flaws by COVID-19, which had a detrimental effect on people's lives, communities, and economy.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: *COVID-19 **revealed **__structural weaknesses in health systems worldwide and negatively impacted individuals, societies, and economies.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**The meanings of the rest of the options are given below:

 
• **Concealed**: To hide something or keep it secret. ( छुपाया)

 
 
• Example: She concealed her true feelings from everyone.
 
 
 
• **Laid**: To put something down, especially in a flat position. (रखा) 
 
 
• Example: The worker laid the bricks carefully on the ground.
 
 
 
• **Hit**: To come into forceful contact with something. (मारा)
 
 
• Example: The car hit the pole during the accident.
